items.question: What should I do if I smell natural gas?
items.answer: Leave the area immediately by foot, avoid anything that could create a spark, and call 911 and SiEnergy at 888-468-7007, Option 1, from a safe location.

items.question: How do I start, stop, or transfer natural gas service?
items.answer: Visit Service Options to start, stop, or transfer service and review the information needed for your request.

items.question: Where can I find help paying my bill?
items.answer: Visit Payment Options & Locations for available payment methods and assistance resources, or call 888-468-7007, Option 3, for customer service.

items.question: When should I call 811?
items.answer: Contact 811 before every digging project so underground utilities can be located and marked before work begins.
